card.name: Exposure noun before "associated with"
card.fires_on: The noun naming a drug exposure (use, therapy, pregnancy) right after a drug class such as PPI, where the next words are likely "is/may be associated with an increased risk".

card.writes: It pushes the model to expect the word "associated" next, but the listed tokens do not show this directly; the suppressed tokens are all forms of "associated".
card.plain: It marks the spot in a warning where a drug exposure is named and the text is about to say it is "associated with" a risk.
